content.short: Blitz TCG is a Cardano trading card game mixing NFT ownership, TCG strategy, MOBA ideas, and tactical play.
content.description: Blitz TCG is a digital trading card game that mixes classic TCG strategy with ideas from MOBAs and chess-like timing systems. Players manage resources such as Gold and XP, choose a General, and build strategies around access to their full deck rather than only random draws. The project uses Cardano to support digital ownership and collectible game assets while keeping gameplay at the center. Its goal is to offer a competitive card game with fresh mechanics for Web3 players, collectors, and strategy fans.
